papers.title: Short-term hypoxic preconditioning promotes prevascularization in 3D bioprinted bone constructs with stromal vascular fraction derived cells.
papers.abstract: Reconstruction of complex, craniofacial bone defects often requires autogenous vascularized bone grafts, and still remains a challenge today. In order to address this issue, we isolated the stromal vascular fraction (SVF) from adipose tissues and maintained the phenotypes and the growth of endothelial lineage cells within SVF derived cells (SVFC) by incorporating an endothelial cell medium. We 3D bioprinted SVFC within our hydrogel bioinks and conditioned the constructs in either normoxia or hypoxia. We found that short-term hypoxic conditioning promoted vascularization-related gene expression, whereas long-term hypoxia impaired cell viability and vascularization. 3D bioprinted bone constructs composed of polycaprolactone/hydroxyapatite (PCL/HAp) and SVFC-laden hydrogel bioinks were then implanted into athymic mice, after conditioning in normoxic or short-term hypoxic environments, in order to determine the in vitro and in vivo vascularization and osteogenic differentiation of the constructs. Short-term hypoxic conditioning promoted microvessel formation in vitro and in vivo and promoted integration with existing host vasculature, but did not affect osteogenic differentiation of SVFC. These findings demonstrate the benefit of short-term hypoxia and the potential for utilization of SVFC and 3D bioprinting for generating prevascularized 3D bioprinted bone constructs. Furthermore, the ability to custom design complex anatomical shapes has promising applications for the regeneration of both large and small craniofacial bone defects.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D生物打印和缺氧预处理，但完全没有AI/ML方法，不直接相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not incorporate any AI/ML method into the bioprinting workflow.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决颅面骨缺损修复中需要血管化骨移植的问题。
summary_zh.method: 3D生物打印含SVFC的水凝胶-支架复合物并进行短时低氧预处理。
summary_zh.result: 短时低氧促进体内外微血管形成并整合宿主血管，但未影响成骨分化。
summary_zh.validation: 体外基因表达与体内小鼠皮下移植验证血管化效果。

summary_en.motivation: To address the need for vascularized bone grafts in craniofacial defect reconstruction.
summary_en.method: 3D bioprinted constructs incorporating stromal vascular fraction cells within hydrogel bioinks were subjected to short-term hypoxic preconditioning.
summary_en.result: Short-term hypoxia promoted microvessel formation in vitro and in vivo and enhanced integration with host vasculature without affecting osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: Validation through in vitro gene expression analysis and in vivo implantation in athymic mice.

papers.title: Batched Large-scale Bayesian Optimization in High-dimensional Spaces
papers.abstract: Bayesian optimization (BO) has become an effective approach for black-box function optimization problems when function evaluations are expensive and the optimum can be achieved within a relatively small number of queries. However, many cases, such as the ones with high-dimensional inputs, may require a much larger number of observations for optimization. Despite an abundance of observations thanks to parallel experiments, current BO techniques have been limited to merely a few thousand observations. In this paper, we propose ensemble Bayesian optimization (EBO) to address three current challenges in BO simultaneously: (1) large-scale observations; (2) high dimensional input spaces; and (3) selections of batch queries that balance quality and diversity. The key idea of EBO is to operate on an ensemble of additive Gaussian process models, each of which possesses a randomized strategy to divide and conquer. We show unprecedented, previously impossible results of scaling up BO to tens of thousands of observations within minutes of computation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的集成贝叶斯优化方法可处理高维、大规模观测数据，适用于昂贵仿真优化，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计约束。
llm.why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP, and no biomedical or implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有贝叶斯优化难以处理高维和大规模观测数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出集成贝叶斯优化，使用多个加性高斯过程模型并行处理。
summary_zh.result: 在数万观测点内实现高效优化，计算时间仅需数分钟。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准黑箱函数基准上验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization struggles with high-dimensional inputs and large-scale observations due to computational bottlenecks.
summary_en.method: Ensemble Bayesian optimization (EBO) employs an ensemble of additive Gaussian process models with randomized divide-and-conquer strategies.
summary_en.result: EBO scales Bayesian optimization to tens of thousands of observations within minutes, achieving unprecedented efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validated on synthetic benchmark functions for high-dimensional and large-scale optimization.
